svg.aria-label: Left: the squares of a missing south wing with W on the west side of C and S on its own axis, at v = 0, s = 0.55, d = 0.75, in the smallest disk that allows these separations (radius 1.704); the separating lines of the stress with the weights 4, 10, 3, 3 and its forces; the force on S, of length about 13, lies close to the own axis of S. Right: the domain of (v, s) at d = 11/14, shaded by the profile, with the lower bounds of Table D.8
